newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SNS completes takeover Dutch unit Banque de Suez.
newsitem.headline: SNS completes takeover Dutch unit Banque de Suez.

text.p: Unlisted Dutch SNS Bank Nederland NV said on Monday it had completed the takeover of Banque de Suez Nederland NV.
"The takeover of Banque de Suez Nederland by SNS Bank Nederland has now been effected," SNS and Banque de Suez Nederland said in a statement.
"This means that Suez Nederland Securities has also become part of SNS Bank Nederland NV," it added.
SNS bank Nederland is a unit of the SNS groep NV, which is primarily active in banking, insurance and asset management.
Banque de Suez Nederland NV was formerly a 100 percent owned subsidiary of Banque Indosuez SA, which was recently acquired by Credit Agricole.
